lightshade.menu.preset_tip: Sets shadows, reflections, clouds, light shafts and contact shading. Colours, sun and moon stay as you set them.
lightshade.menu.added: %s added and chosen. Apply or Done to use it.
lightshade.menu.not_a_pack: %s is not a Lightshade pack (no lightshade.json).
lightshade.menu.not_a_zip: %s is not a ZIP file or a pack folder.

lightshade.menu.settings_changed: Shader Settings · %s changed from the pack's defaults

lightshade.pack.daylight.desc: Clean vanilla+: warm sun and cool sky-blue shade, soft shadows, clear turquoise water, refined clouds and cosy torchlight. Light on the GPU.
lightshade.pack.aurora.desc: Cinematic: volumetric clouds, calm golden sunsets, glassy water with soft caustics, the Milky Way and emerald northern lights, wet ground in storms, moody Nether and End.
lightshade.option.SKY_FILL.desc: How much cool blue sky light fills the shade. Higher gives brighter, bluer shadows; lower gives deeper contrast.
lightshade.option.LIGHT_NIGHT.desc: Moonlight and night sky. Lower is darker; 100% is a dark night where shapes still read.
lightshade.option.TORCH_BRIGHTNESS.desc: Brightness of torches, lanterns, campfires and other lamps. Their light is warm and falls off into the dark.
lightshade.option.HELD_LIGHTING.desc: A torch or lantern in your hand lights up what is near you.
lightshade.option.AMBIENT_OCCLUSION.desc: Soft darkening in corners, where blocks meet and under trees, on top of Minecraft's own.
lightshade.option.TORCH_HAZE.desc: A soft halo of light in the air around flames and lamps at night.
lightshade.option.GLOW_POWER.desc: How far lamps, lava and fire outshine everything else.
lightshade.option.SURFACE_DETAIL.desc: Stone, wood and earth get depth from their own texture.
lightshade.option.SHADOWS.desc: Real shadows from the sun and moon. Off is the fastest setting.
lightshade.option.SHADOW_STRENGTH.desc: How dark the sun's shadows are. The sky still fills them with cool light.
lightshade.option.SHADOW_SOFTNESS.desc: How soft shadow edges are. Higher blurs them more, especially far from what casts them.
lightshade.option.SHADOW_RESOLUTION.desc: Sharper shadows cost more video memory and time.
lightshade.option.SHADOW_DISTANCE.desc: How far from you shadows are drawn.
lightshade.option.SHADOW_CASCADES.desc: Extra shadow maps close to you: edges stay sharp near you while the range stays long. Each one costs a little more.
lightshade.option.CLOUD_SHADOWS.desc: Clouds drop soft shadows that sweep over the land.
lightshade.option.WATER_WAVES.desc: Wave height on water. Zero makes still water.
lightshade.option.WATER_REFLECTIVITY.des: How strongly water mirrors the sky and the land.
lightshade.option.WATER_REFLECTION_QUALI: Off shows only the sky in water. Higher finds hills, trees and buildings too, at some cost.
lightshade.option.WATER_SMOOTHNESS.desc: Higher keeps the long swells and calms the small ripples.
lightshade.option.WATER_DEPTH.desc: How quickly deeper water turns from clear turquoise to deep teal.
lightshade.option.WATER_FOAM.desc: A thin line of foam where the water meets the land.
lightshade.option.WATER_CAUSTICS.desc: Soft webs of sunlight drifting over the bottom of shallow water.
lightshade.option.SUN_TILT.desc: How far the path of the sun leans to the south, in degrees. Leaning, it lights north and south walls differently and shadows fall at an angle. 0 is Minecraft's path straight overhead.
lightshade.option.SUN_SIZE.desc: Size of the sun in the sky and in water.
lightshade.option.SUN_GLOW.desc: How bright the sun burns and how far its halo spreads.
lightshade.option.SKY_GOLDEN.desc: How strongly sunrise and sunset paint the sky gold, apricot and indigo.
lightshade.option.CLOUD_QUALITY.desc: Off removes the clouds. Higher gives fuller, softer clouds.
lightshade.option.CLOUD_COVER.desc: How much of the sky the clouds cover.
lightshade.option.CLOUD_SILVER_LINING.de: Bright edges where the sun shines through the clouds.
lightshade.option.SKY_AURORA.desc: Emerald and teal curtains of light low in the northern sky on clear nights.
lightshade.option.SKY_MILKY_WAY.desc: A band of faint stars and dust across the clear night sky.
lightshade.option.SKY_SHOOTING_STARS.des: Now and then a meteor crosses the night sky.
lightshade.option.WAVING_PLANTS.desc: Grass, flowers, crops and hanging vines move in the wind.
lightshade.option.FOLIAGE_GLOW.desc: Leaves and grass light up when the sun is behind them.
lightshade.option.RAIN_PUDDLES.desc: In rain the ground turns dark and glossy and puddles mirror the sky.
lightshade.option.VIBRANCE.desc: Lifts dull colours more than strong ones, so grass and sky do not look washed out.
lightshade.option.BLOOM_STRENGTH.desc: Soft glow around fire, lava, lamps and the sun.
lightshade.option.VIGNETTE.desc: Darkens the corners of the picture a little.
lightshade.option.ATMOSPHERE.desc: Air between you and far land: distant mountains take a soft tint of the sky. Higher is hazier.
lightshade.option.GODRAYS.desc: Shafts of light from the sun through leaves, hills and windows.
lightshade.option.GODRAYS_STRENGTH.desc: How bright the light shafts are.
lightshade.option.VOLUMETRIC_LIGHT.desc: Sunlight in the air itself, cut by the shadows of trees and mountains. Uses the shadow map; costs more than light shafts.
lightshade.option.VOLUMETRIC_STRENGTH.de: How thick the light in the air looks.
